no_model_OSD-56_sample_metadata.content: 5 donors (A, C, G, H, P) x 2 conditions: 1G by RWV vs uG by RWV, human peripheral blood lymphocytes
no_model_OSD-56_sample_metadata.why_no_model: Metadata only, no numbers / no gene expression values in the file. A 1G-vs-uG classifier needs the expression matrix for these 10 samples. Upload that file and this becomes a clean paired binary task.

no_model_GLDS-615.content: Myoblasts (muscle precursor cells), OSD-684, 12 samples, RIN 9.0-9.5 for first 6, 7.2-9.0 for last 6
no_model_GLDS-615.why_no_model: QC metrics only, no normalized counts file uploaded for GLDS-615. Bone & Muscle therefore has no trainable model in this upload. Upload GLDS-615 normalized counts to train a muscle model.

bone_muscle_gap.gap_in_uploaded_csvs: No bone density, muscle mass, exercise adherence, or bone/muscle label in any of the 10 uploaded CSV files.
bone_muscle_gap.replacement: Model 7 (nhanes_bone_risk) is trained on NHANES 2013-2014 DXA + grip + activity + sleep instead, and NASA OSD-342 (mouse plasma proteomics, flight vs ground) is the spaceflight-side evidence for bone/muscle loss. See combined_data_plan.md.
bone_muscle_gap.proxy_in_old_models: MMASH activity (total_steps, mean_vector_magnitude) is used as an exercise proxy inside Models 1 and 2 only.
bone_muscle_gap.what_to_upload_next: Exercise logs with sets/reps, bone density, muscle strength, or GLDS-615 normalized counts.
